basic_info.description: Gorgeous newly constructed home in Noe Valley! This brand new home has it all. Its semi detached on extra large lot. There are 4 bedrooms on top floor. Large scale public rooms with dramatic floor to ceiling windows. Living room has city views. Beautiful kitchen family room combo has direct access to garden perfect for entertainment. Gorgeous kitchen equipped with Thermadore appliances. Lower level offers another en-suite, office and full bathroom. Amenities include air conditioning, wine closet, retractible roof and expansive roof deck w/ fantastic views.... Great quiet cul-de sac-Noe Valley location.
